experiment: assemble3 acceptance of $qraw replacements in compiler-candidate operand slots
scope: Each operand token in one compiler-generated parser-arity fixture for each syntax candidate was replaced by $qraw. This establishes parser fallback behavior for those slots only; it does not establish assembler acceptance, complete ISA spelling coverage, or legality.
